warnings: This set (แบบอาคารฝึกงาน 204/27, 6 large sheets, scanned) prints NO grid bubbles — only dimension chains with tick circles. Labels were assigned following the precedent of houses 155/157 (other unlabelled สพฐ. sets): numbers 1-9 on the nine column lines along x (8 bays x 4.00 = 32.00, left to right as drawn, grid 9 = the right end wall), letters on the column rows along y with A at the top of the plan as drawn. Origin A1 (top-left).

Rows A (0.00) and D (10.00) are the long column rows (F2C2 at grids 2-8, F1C1 at the end walls). Rows B (3.25) and C (6.75) carry columns only at the two end walls (F1C1 at grids 1 and 9); inside the building they are beam lines (B2) framing into the 10.00 m transverse beams B3/B4. All four carry columns, so all four are named lines.

B' (5.00) is the ridge line and the line of the small columns C0 (grids 5 and 6) and the B2 partition beam of the teacher-room block. It is not dimensioned on any plan; its position comes from the steel-truss detail on sheet 6 (panel chain 1.25 x 8 = 10.00, ridge after 4 panels) and is the midpoint of the printed 3.50 bay. Lower score on that line.

Three different outer edges are printed outside rows A and D and all three become dummies: the ground-floor walkway edge 1.80 (A''' / D'), the upper-floor cantilevered corridor edge 2.00 (A'' / D'') and the roof eave 2.50 (A' / D'''). Before-origin dummies share A's prime sequence top-to-bottom (section 4): A' -2.50, A'' -2.00, A''' -1.80.
The stair bay beyond grid 9 is 1.80 on every plan (9' = 33.80; total 33.80 printed on the ground-floor plan).

z: the central level chain of section ก-ก prints 0.20 / 0.20 / 4.00 / 3.00 / 1.00 / 3.30 / 1.10 from ระดับดิน ±0.00; labelled levels +0.20, +0.40, +4.35, +4.40-4.45 come from the same section. The upper five are unlabelled and typed dummy. Section ข-ข repeats the floor levels; its level chain was not transcribed separately.

Dimension sweep: sheet 5 (page 06: the three plans), sheet 1 (page 02: both floor plans + door detail ป1), sheet 2 (page 03: sections ก-ก / ข-ข) and sheet 6 (page 07: the truss panel chain and the gable-section chain; its stair riser/tread chains and the slab span notes '1.75 ~ 2.00' / '3.25 ~ 3.50' are element-internal and stay on the elements / were not transcribed). Element-internal dimensions (beam/column/slab section sizes, footing plan sizes and pile spacing, the B9 cantilever detail on sheet 2, truss panel spacing, stair riser/tread chains) stay on their elements, not here (section 4 rule 4 exception). Sheet 3 (page 04, elevations) prints no dimensions. Sheet 4 (page 05, architectural window/door/sink/eave/blackboard details) was swept for its legible values (all element-internal → unassigned_dimensions; the eave 2.50 is the A'-A tick); a few small values in the sink section 1-1, the roof-edge moulding detail and the lowest step of the น1 height chain are illegible at this scan quality and are not transcribed. The stair-bay chains on the ground-floor plan (beside the stair) are stair-internal and are not transcribed.
Page 01 is the sharer's cover ('แบบรูปรายการใช้สำหรับ ปีงบประมาณ 2562'), not part of the drawing set.
